finding: One-step conservative surgery was possible in 85.3% of placenta accreta spectrum cases and resulted in similar clinical outcomes compared to cesarean delivery with hysterectomy, except for lower rates of transfusions and vascular interventions.
mod_finding: The study compared outcomes between cesarean delivery with hysterectomy and a uterine-sparing surgical technique for placenta accreta spectrum, finding that the latter was associated with lower rates of transfusions and vascular interventions.
